decisions.reason: The charting bundle extends the core map.apps platform at low maintenance cost, and with industry growth providing slack, its absence from the website in 2020 to 2021 is not a clear enough shortfall against aspirations to trigger withdrawal.

The hierarchical search bundle is a minor, low-visibility plugin whose disappearance from the website hints at weak results, but it is cheap to keep inside the platform, so dropping it frees few resources.
As the flagship platform line that defines the firm's strategic direction, it remains central to the firm's aspirations and will be kept regardless of limited website visibility.
Mobile field data capture meets core customer needs, but competition from major platform providers' own mobile apps creates some risk of a shortfall; slack allows the firm to keep it for now.
